question_text: An object travels 20m East and then 20m West in 10 seconds. What is its average velocity?
explanation: Velocity is displacement over time. Total displacement is 0 because it returned to the starting point.
distractor_rationale: Students who choose 4 m/s confused velocity with speed (distance/time).

ai_context.learning_goal: Apply the difference between speed and velocity in calculations.
common_misconceptions: Thinking distance is used for velocity instead of displacement.
ai_context.hint: What is the net displacement of the object?
